artifact_observations.reasoning: The trigger guard appears slightly fused or ill-defined where it meets the lower receiver. The geometry lacks the crisp, separate mechanical definition expected of a real firearm, looking slightly 'melted' or soft.
The magazine lacks distinct ribbing or texture details often found on real polymer magazines. It appears as a smooth, featureless black shape, which is a common AI simplification artifact.

The lines of the handguard seem to converge slightly inconsistently with the receiver, suggesting minor perspective warping typical of generative models struggling with rigid mechanical straight lines.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'trigger guard' area. AI models often fail to render the empty space within the trigger guard correctly, leading to fusion artifacts. Also, verify if the magazine insertion point looks physically plausible or if it floats/fuses into the well. The missing stock is a framing issue, not necessarily a generation defect, but evaluate the visible mechanics strictly.
